response.rationale: The T1 Li 2016 meta-analysis finds aptitude correlates with L2 proficiency, and the T4 studies (DeKeyser 2000, Abrahamsson 2008) and the T6 Hyltenstam 2016 summary agree, especially for late learners; the two T3 working-memory and executive-control items only support it indirectly, and talk:23 is labeled positive but its own text says it contradicts the claim (it is a weak T6 source that cites the same supporting literature), so confidence is high but not maximal.
